id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying a connection to a hibernated branch

review.posthog_relevance: PostHog warehouse ingestion and recovery; distinguishes permanent PostgreSQL branch hibernation from transient failures, preventing unnecessary retry loops and surfacing actionable remediation instructions.
review.reason: Adds a permanent, non-retryable error entry for the message 'branch is hibernated' and its associated user-facing guidance, and adds a test case asserting that the hibernated-branch error message is recognized as a permanent, non-retryable error, even when other connection attempts fail.
